messages:
Maya: kicking off a multi-region perf sweep: compare replay vs synth for KV priming, kernel-selection sampling, and batching tails. regions: us-east1 <-> eu-west1. keeping this thread for quick notes.
Liam: SGTM. what's the synthetic qps and how are we scaling replay? want same p50 path lengths.
Maya: synth=520 qps global (55/45 split), replay is prod trace from last Thursday scaled to match token-rate and session stickiness. will attach harness config.
Raj: important: capture kernel_id per inference and per-shard timings. also collect batch-size timeline.
Maya: yes — profiling hooks on. also running a forced-kernel pass (kernel=attn-fused-opt) after auto runs.
Sophia: what about KV warm modes? replay normally primes better but we should measure eviction churn.
Maya: three modes: cold, replay-warm (session-ordered), synth-warm (synthetic sessions with same prefixes). metrics: kv_hit_rate, kv_evictions, kv_lat_ms, batch_size_hist.
Alex: lock batching params across runs so it's apples-to-apples. I'm writing them into the harness.
Maya: harness snippet:
```
batch_max_tokens: 3072
batch_max_latency_ms: 10
batching_mode: continuous
kv_cache_mb: 1536
```
Deploy-bot: run 1893456789 started at 2026-01-15T14:00:00Z
bench-bot: profiling enabled. sample_interval_ms=250. collecting kernel callcounts, per-kernel latencies, batch histograms, kv metrics per-shard.
Liam: early signal: us-east p50 +10ms on replay vs synth, p95 +35ms. replay shows heavier batching.
Maya: can we get batch-size CDF and per-kernel distribution?
bench-bot: summary (uploaded): s3://redwood-bench/1893456789/{profiles,kv,batched}.tgz
- replay median batch size: 16
- synth median batch size: 8
- kernel distribution (replay): attn-fused-opt 58%, attn-vanilla 22%, layernorm-quant 20%
- kernel distribution (synth): attn-fused-opt 41%, attn-vanilla 33%, layernorm-quant 26%
- kv_hit_rate after 2k sessions: replay-warm 78%, synth-warm 49%
- kv_evictions per-min (replay): 12, (synth): 34
- avg_kv_lookup_ms: replay 0.85, synth 1.1
Raj: pattern: replay increases KV hits and reduces compute but increases queueing due to larger batches -> tail impact. tradeoff space as expected.
Sophia: idea: region-aware priming before drain, push hot KV keys to standing cache in the cold region. test that in next run.
Maya: scheduling follow-up: set batch_max_latency_ms=6, add kv-snapshot prewarm step, and run forced-kernel pass. also run a 30s progressive drain: shift 25% traffic eu->us.
Alex: add run-level alert: if cross-region p99 > 1.8s -> abort drain and revert routing.
Maya: ack. next run starting in ~12m. tagging @Raj for analysis doc.
bench-bot: finished run 1893456789. full artifacts at s3 link above. flamegraphs and per-kernel traces in profiles/.
Liam: quick notes: 1) replay-warm gives ~30% token-cost reduction via KV hits, 2) tail increases mostly at p95+ due to batching, 3) lowering latency cutoff to 6ms reduces p95 by ~18% but increases small-token CPU overhead.
Raj: I'll draft short comparison doc: options = adaptive latency cutoff (qps-aware), prewarm KV snapshots before drain, and lightweight kernel-fallback for small-batch requests. include cost vs latency estimates.
Maya: sweet. I'll open PR with artifacts + config diffs. thanks all. :rocket:
Deploy-bot: thread closed at 1893457042
